text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Watching the Umamusume run so brilliantly earlier...
Well, it left my heart feeling... a little restless."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I tried to redirect my focus to calm down...
and thought about all sorts of other things, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I think I just felt relieved
once I found you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Still, whenever I remember that run...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I shouldn't...
Haa... gotta think about... something else...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes... If I just watch you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love gazed back with a relieved smile,
though her headache still seemed to linger...
